en.headline: sogeisetsu: 335 commits, 25 PRs, 52 issues across 16 repos
en.teaser: A month of skill packaging and upstream bug reporting: 17 asset-inventory releases, four deep-research releases, and 52 issues filed on OpenChamber, opencode and related tools.
en.overview:
Between 2026-09-18 and 2026-10-17 the account recorded 335 commits, 25 pull requests and 52 issues across 16 repositories, with no reviews. The work split between the author's own Agent Skills packages and a long list of upstream bug reports against the OpenCode ecosystem.

### Own skill repositories

`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` was the busiest repository: 139 own commits, 16 pull requests and 17 releases in the window. The release train moved from v1.3.0 to v1.15.0, covering the English-first docs restructure, seven fixed-string languages in the glossary, rendered bilingual sample pages, a Material docs site, automated documentation checks, a five-state marker scheme including a broken state, and a registry-first host-command scan. Later releases added a skills.sh one-line install and a workflow-first SKILL.md.

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` landed 76 own commits and four releases. v0.1.0 was the first tag, v0.2.0 hardened the research protocol with rules for unreachable sources and clearer validator messages, v0.3.0 split the work into three cooperating skills with three hard gates, and v0.4.0 introduced a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the six gate scripts and added a bilingual landing page.

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` contributed 24 own commits and four releases through v1.4.0. The skill gained an offline price seed, agent discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, proxy-aware shared helpers, BOM-tolerant atomic JSON writes, and clearer fallback-chain diagnostics.

### Reports, profile and helpers

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` saw 83 own commits plus 276 automated commits, mostly daily activity-card regeneration workflows: English copy, a 30-day activity card, a rolling two-hour report schedule, a manual date input for the report workflow, and CI upgrades off the deprecated Node 20 runtime. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` added 10 own commits of archived knowledge notes on OpenCode distribution, auth and Windows path issues. `sogeisetsu/myBlog` received 3 own commits, all OpenChamber capture samples, and `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-creator` had 5 automated commits with no own commits.

### Upstream issue work

The remaining repositories were upstream projects where no commits were made. `openchamber/openchamber` carried 28 issues, including multi-run MCP process leaks, a Context panel breakdown bar bug, browser-capture resolution, missing auto-update manifests in v2.0.1, and stale-save clobbering of AGENTS.md; several were closed during the window. `anomalyco/opencode` accounted for 12 issues, largely MiMo-V2.6-Flash vision and subagent failures plus a Windows desktop CLI gap. `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` saw 8 pull requests and 4 issues about V1 plugin API load errors, CRLF frontmatter validation, review-server disposal and eval robustness. Smaller reports were filed against `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`, `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`, `vercel-labs/skills`, `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills` and the two `OpenSenseNova` skill repositories, mostly OpenCode V2 compatibility and skill-listing requests.

### Data notes

No days are missing: all 30 days of the window carry data. Dates from 2026-09-18 through 2026-10-01 were reconstructed via GitHub Search and are approximate — star counts are unavailable and releases cover only the user's own repositories.

Submission pull request adding the sogeisetsu/asset-inventory skill to the list.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：16 个仓库共 335 次提交、25 个 PR、52 个 issue
zh.teaser: 这个月主要在做技能打包和上游问题上报：asset-inventory 发了 17 个版本，meld-deepresearch 发了 4 个，并在 OpenChamber、opencode 等上游提了 52 个 issue。
zh.overview:
2026-09-18 至 2026-10-17 期间，该账号在 16 个仓库中产生 335 次提交、25 个 pull request、52 个 issue，评审数为 0。工作分为两部分：自己维护的 Agent Skill 项目，以及对 OpenCode 生态上游项目的一批缺陷上报。

### 自有技能仓库

`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 是本期最活跃的仓库：139 次本人提交、16 个 PR、17 个 release。版本从 v1.3.0 一路走到 v1.15.0，内容包括英文优先的文档重构、词表扩展到七种固定字符串语言、双语渲染样例页、Material 文档站、文档自动化检查、新增 `🛑broken` 状态标记、发现与探测环节的安全约束、release 准备脚本、skills.sh 一行安装，以及以注册表为先的宿主命令扫描。

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 有 76 次本人提交和 4 个 release。v0.1.0 是首个标签；v0.2.0 为无法打开的来源补上处理规则并改进校验提示；v0.3.0 把单一技能拆成三个协作技能并加了三道硬门槛；v0.4.0 引入封装六个门槛脚本的 `meld.py` 命令行，并补上支持明暗主题的双语落地页。

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 有 24 次本人提交、4 个 release，推进到 v1.4.0。期间加入离线价格种子、agent 发现与快照摘要脚本、支持代理的共享辅助函数、容忍 BOM 的原子 JSON 写入，以及更清晰的回退链诊断。

### 统计站点、知识与辅助项目

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 83 次本人提交，另有 276 次自动提交，主要是活动卡片的每日自动更新：全文改为英文、新增近 30 天活动卡片、日报改为每两小时滚动更新并支持手动指定日期、修正提交口径、用 .gitattributes 统一 LF 换行、忽略 `.opencode`，并把 checkout/setup-node 升级到 v7 以摆脱已弃用的 Node 20 运行时。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 有 10 次本人提交，沉淀了 OpenCode 分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径问题的知识笔记。`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 有 3 次本人提交，全部是 OpenChamber 截图样例；`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-creator` 有 5 次自动提交，没有本人提交。

### 上游 issue 与 PR

其余仓库均为上游项目，本期没有提交。`openchamber/openchamber` 有 28 个 issue，集中在多轮运行的生命周期问题：MCP 子进程残留导致 worktree 删除失败、Context 面板明细条按最后一条消息计算、浏览器截图按 CSS 像素导出、v2.0.1 缺少自动更新清单、外部修改 AGENTS.md 后被静默覆盖，以及被合并的回合隐藏了较早回答；其中若干已关闭，并新开了若干 idea 讨论。`anomalyco/opencode` 有 12 个 issue，主要是 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 视觉与子代理失败，以及 Windows 桌面版自带 CLI 却无法启动。`antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 有 8 个 PR 和 4 个 issue，涉及 V1 插件 API 加载失败、CRLF 前置元数据校验、插件卸载时释放评审服务以及评测健壮性。`alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`、`iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`、`vercel-labs/skills`、`VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills` 和两个 `OpenSenseNova` 技能仓库也收到了少量反馈，多为 OpenCode V2 兼容性与技能收录请求。

### 数据说明

窗口 30 天没有缺失日期，每天都有数据。2026-09-18 至 2026-10-01 的日期通过 GitHub Search 回填，属于近似值：星标数不可用，release 仅覆盖用户自己的仓库。

highlights.text: v1.7.0 的 pull request 被合并，带来七种语言、Material 文档站和渲染后的示例。
宿主命令扫描改为注册表优先，直接从应用包的命令注册表枚举，而不再依赖文本查找。
把单一研究技能拆成三个协作技能，并设置三道硬性交付门槛。
新增 discover-agents.mjs 与 snapshot-summary.mjs 脚本，并在推荐表中加入角色概览列。
测试文件仍在使用已删除的多轮运行属性，本期新开并随后关闭。
Go 端点对 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 的图片输入一律返回 400，已于 2026-10-17 关闭。
OpenCode V2 兼容性问题报告：V1 插件 API 下出现 PluginModule.LoadError。
提交 pull request，把 sogeisetsu/asset-inventory 技能加入清单。
